# Swiftrooms AE — Local Static Clone

## Running locally

```bash
cd dist
python3 -m http.server 8080
```

Then open http://localhost:8080 in your browser.

## Structure

```
dist/
  index.html          # Home page (swiftrooms.ae/)
  pages/              # All other pages by URL alias
  assets/
    css/              # Stylesheets
    js/               # JavaScript
    images/           # Images, SVGs
    embeds/           # YouTube embed HTML stubs
```
